_comment: Three to four backgrounds per rank. Attribute bonuses add to the player's allocation; skills start at the given levels (0-100); trade is the starting trade for peasants. Family templates describe who exists at the start.

ranks.name: Peasant
ranks.blurb: A free tenant with a hut, a few coins and a trade. The ground floor.

backgrounds.name: Farmer's son
backgrounds.blurb: You grew up behind the plough. Strong back, few prospects.

backgrounds.name: Smith's apprentice
backgrounds.blurb: Your master died of the flux last winter and left you his forge and his debts.

backgrounds.name: Poacher
backgrounds.blurb: You know the deer trails better than the forester does. He knows your name.

backgrounds.name: Miller's widow
backgrounds.blurb: The mill is yours now, and every man in the village thinks he should have it instead.

ranks.name: Warrior
ranks.blurb: A free sword: weapon, armour, small savings, no master.

backgrounds.name: Flemish mercenary
backgrounds.blurb: You came over with the companies Stephen hired. The pay stopped; you stayed.

backgrounds.name: Veteran of the Welsh march
backgrounds.blurb: Ten years holding a border tower against the Welsh. You limp when it rains.

backgrounds.name: Outlawed squire
backgrounds.blurb: You killed a man in a quarrel over a horse. The horse is yours; the county is not.

ranks.name: Knight
ranks.blurb: A household knight: sworn, fed, and owned.

backgrounds.name: Younger son
backgrounds.blurb: Your brother has the land. You have the sword and the obligation.

backgrounds.name: Dubbed on the field
backgrounds.blurb: You were a sergeant until a lord saw you hold a gate. Nobody at table lets you forget it.

backgrounds.name: Hostage returned
backgrounds.blurb: Twelve years in another lord's hall as surety for your father's loyalty. You speak better French than English.

ranks.name: Lord
ranks.blurb: A small castle, a village that pays you, a garrison, and rivals.

backgrounds.name: New man
backgrounds.blurb: Henry raised your father from the dust. The old families remember the dust.

backgrounds.name: Old blood
backgrounds.blurb: Your grandfather came over with the Conqueror. The castle is older than the kingdom and leaks.

backgrounds.name: Widow regent
backgrounds.blurb: Your husband died at Henry's court. You hold the castle for a son of nine. Everyone wants to marry you.

ranks.name: King or Queen
ranks.blurb: The contested crown. Everything at once.

backgrounds.name: Stephen of Blois
backgrounds.blurb: Crowned, doubted. Brave in the field, too forgiving at the table.

backgrounds.name: Empress Matilda
backgrounds.blurb: Rightful, resisted. Daughter of a king, widow of an emperor, wife of an Angevin.

backgrounds.name: A bastard of Henry
backgrounds.blurb: One of the old king's many by-blows, with a forged charter and a few hundred men who believe it.
